systems.name: LeanEuclid & Formal System E
systems.underlying_algebra_or_logic: Avigad-Dean-Mumma Formal System E embedded in Lean 4: 6-sorted constructive signature separating 30 construction axioms, 36 diagrammatic/topological axioms, and 35 linear real metric/transfer axioms.
systems.metric_treatment: Real-valued linear magnitudes mapped to ℝ: segment length |(a─b)|, angle measure ∠(a:b:c), triangle area △(a:b:c), and constant RightAngle (∟); avoids non-linear trigonometry.
systems.diorismos_and_degeneracy: Explicit topological preconditions on every construction rule (Point.sameSide, Point.opposingSides, between, insideCircle, outsideCircle) discharged automatically by external SMT solvers.
systems.verification_engine: Hybrid Lean 4 proof script + external Z3/CVC5 translation; note forensic finding in SystemE/Meta/Smt/Solver.lean:44-55 where SMT_VERIF (P : Prop) : P acts as an unverified trust-oracle axiom.
systems.signature_opus_scale: 235 .lean files, 206 theorems, 108 axioms: complete Euclid Book I (Prop01-Prop48 + 24 primed variants + 6 missed-by-Euclid lemmas in Prop47) plus 100 circle-free UniGeo theorems.
strengths: Faithfully formalizes diagrammatic topological reasoning (Pasch, circle-circle and line-circle intersection existence) that Euclid used implicitly.
Separates explicit construction steps (euclid_apply) from tedious topological case splits (euclid_finish).
Its 7 Intersections.lean rules correspond 1-to-1 with geometor.model.intersect selectors (side_of, between, beyond).
blind_spots: Closes proof obligations via axiom SMT_VERIF (P : Prop) : P without reconstructing proof terms inside the Lean 4 kernel.
Stops after Euclid Book I (omits Books II-XIII, proportion algebra, circle power/inversion, all triangle centers X(1)-X(5), and projective geometry).
All 100 UniGeo benchmarks contain zero Circle occurrences.
systems.geometor_takeaway: Persist selector ASTs on geometor.model.Step so exact compass-and-straightedge DAGs can emit 1-to-1 System E construction transcripts while verifying algebraic invariants inside SymPy without an SMT trust oracle.

systems.name: GeoCoq (Tarski / Hilbert / Euclid)
primitives: Cong A B C D (4-point segment equidistance)
systems.underlying_algebra_or_logic: Schwabhäuser-Szmielew-Tarski first-order axiomatic hierarchy parameterized via 42 Coq Typeclasses (neutral -> Pasch -> continuity -> 34 parallel postulates -> 2D/3D/nD).
systems.metric_treatment: Synthetic congruence equivalence classes plus Hilbert-Tarski geometric segment arithmetic (Sum, Prod, Opp, Inv on a fixed line with unit E in Ch14-Ch16) building an internal ordered Euclidean field.
systems.diorismos_and_degeneracy: Non-strict predicates (Bet A A B holds trivially) paired with explicit A <> B and ~ Col A B C hypotheses in every theorem statement.
systems.verification_engine: 100% kernel-checked Coq proof terms with certified boolean reflection tactics (ColR, CongR, CoincR) requiring zero external solvers.
systems.signature_opus_scale: 481 .v files, 4,671 Lemmas, 42 Classes: Book I (48 props), Ch02-Ch16 Tarski development, bidirectional Tarski <-> Hilbert <-> Euclid equivalences, 34 parallel postulates, Highschool X(1)-X(4) + Euler line, and affine Pappus/Desargues.
strengths: Gold-standard foundational rigor: proves exact metatheoretic bi-interpretability across Tarski, Hilbert, and Euclid axiom systems.
Tracks minimal axiomatic footprint of every theorem (neutral vs. Euclidean vs. continuity, 2D vs. arbitrary dimension).
Kernel-verified reflective tactics (ColR, CongR) automate incidence and congruence transitivity soundly.
blind_spots: Point-only ontology requires existential witnesses for every line or circle construction and makes circle geometry verbose.
Omits Nine-Point Circle X(5), Steiner circle power, radical axis, circle inversion, pole-polar reciprocity, conics, and projective cross-ratio.
Interactive Ltac scripts require hundreds of lines of manual degeneracy management.
systems.geometor_takeaway: Adopt GeoCoq's dependency discipline—tagging whether a theorem requires neutrality, parallel postulate, or circle continuity—while keeping lines, circles, and conics as first-class algebraic citizens.

systems.name: Lean 4 Mathlib (Euclidean & Affine)
systems.underlying_algebra_or_logic: Origin-free affine torsor P over a real InnerProductSpace ℝ V, bridged to metric spaces via dist p₁ p₂ = ‖p₁ -ᵥ p₂‖ and oriented 2D plane angles via Module.Oriented ℝ V (Fin 2).
systems.metric_treatment: Noncomputable classical ℝ with dist, inner product ⟪x, y⟫, unoriented Real.arccos angle ∠ in [0, π], and directed angle ∡ in Real.Angle = ℝ/(2πℤ) where (2 : ℤ) • ∡ encodes line angles mod π.
systems.diorismos_and_degeneracy: Mix of bundled Affine.Simplex ℝ P n (carrying AffineIndependent proof) and totalized junk values on degenerate inputs (inversion c R c = c, ∠ p p q = π/2).
systems.verification_engine: 100% Lean 4 kernel-verified dependent type checking powered by simp, ring, linarith, positivity, and linear_combination.
systems.signature_opus_scale: 46 files (16,844 LOC) in Mathlib/Geometry/Euclidean/ + 24 files (11,708 LOC) in LinearAlgebra/AffineSpace/: n-dimensional Monge point, 3(n+1)-point sphere, Ceva, Stewart, Ptolemy, Sphere.power, inversion, and pole-polar.
strengths: Unmatched dimension-polymorphic generality: circumsphere, Monge point (orthocenter), nine-point sphere, power of a point, inversion, and pole-polar work in arbitrary dimension n.
Directed twice-angle calculus (2 : ℤ) • ∡ x y z cleanly proves cyclic quadrilateral criteria without case splits.
Compositional snake_case naming grammar (conclusion_of_hypothesis) scales cleanly to tens of thousands of lemmas.
blind_spots: Pervasively noncomputable (Classical.choose for circumsphere, Real.arccos for ∠); cannot execute constructions or extract exact radical coordinates.
No constructive Euclid I.1 existence theorem and awkward cyclic/diagrammatic order (20-line TODO in Sphere/Ptolemy.lean:22-41).
Surprisingly omits radicalAxis, projective crossRatio, Menelaus, Pappus, Desargues, and Pascal.
systems.geometor_takeaway: Adopt mathlib4's conclusion_of_hypothesis theorem-naming grammar and Sphere.power/pole/polar API clarity while preserving 100% computable algebraic number fields and explicit construction lineage.

systems.name: AlphaGeometry (DD + AR)
systems.host_language: Python 3 + SciPy HiGHS LP + Transformer LM
primitives: Relational hypergraph nodes (Line, Circle, Direction, Length, Angle, Ratio)
systems.underlying_algebra_or_logic: Forward-chaining Geometry Deductive Database (43 Horn rules in rules.txt) coupled to sparse Fraction Gaussian elimination (AR) over angles mod π, log-lengths, and 1D collinear abscissae.
systems.metric_treatment: Linear angle differences modulo π (AngleTable), multiplicative length ratios via log-differences (RatioTable), and 1D collinear segment sums (DistanceTable); zero squared-length support.
systems.diorismos_and_degeneracy: 68 5-line construction stanzas in defs.txt with non-degeneracy guards (ncoll, npara, sameside, sameclock, obtuse_angle) checked purely on a random float64 sketch.
systems.verification_engine: Symbolic DD+AR saturation graph with minimal premise extraction via scipy.optimize.linprog L1 minimization, guided by a language model proposing auxiliary points.
systems.signature_opus_scale: Solves 25/30 IMO geometry problems (imo_ag_30.txt) and 228/231 JGEX benchmarks (jgex_ag_231.txt) using 68 construction definitions and 43 Horn deduction rules.
strengths: Compact, compositional 68-clause construction vocabulary capable of expressing virtually all Olympiad Euclidean configurations.
Directed full-angle predicate eqangle mod π eliminates acute/obtuse case splits across cyclic quadrilaterals.
Clean separation between deterministic symbolic closure (DD+AR) and heuristic auxiliary-point synthesis (LM).
blind_spots: Critical log-ratio bug in ar.py:425-431, 570-574: RatioTable.add_const_ratio adds m*l1 - n*l2 = 0 on log-lengths (asserting |s1|^m = |s2|^n instead of |s1|/|s2| = m/n).
Cannot state or prove additive squared-length laws (a^2 + b^2 = c^2 or disjoint radical axis), nor prove Pappus/Desargues without auxiliary parallel points.
Relies on float64 sketches for non-degeneracy and orientation guards, and silently drops unprefixed post-';' clauses in 12 defs.txt stanzas.
systems.geometor_takeaway: Use defs.txt's 68 clauses as a functional completeness checklist for geometor.elements 2.0, and pair GEOMETOR's exact algebraic kernel with a sound symbolic DD+AR deductive closure engine for seer and divine.

systems.name: Newclid & Yuclid
systems.underlying_algebra_or_logic: Plugin deductor architecture combining 90+ Horn rules (r00-r91) with symbolic log-prime Ratio/Angle AR in Python and additive length + squared-length AR tables in C++ Yuclid.
systems.metric_treatment: Exact sp.log(m) - sp.log(n) constant ratios (fixing AlphaGeometry's rconst bug), plus lconst, l2const, r2const, lequation, and Yuclid's additive |AB|^2 + |BC|^2 = |AC|^2 AR table.
systems.diorismos_and_degeneracy: Explicit orientation-split similarity/congruence rules (simtri/simtrir, contri/contrir via sameclock), while retaining float close_enough candidate pre-filtering (ATOM = 1e-7).
systems.verification_engine: Deductor saturation with SymEngine/Boost.Rational linear reduction, C++ Yuclid (<0.5s saturation on IMO-30), and agentic heuristic/LLM auxiliary-clause injection (' | ').
systems.signature_opus_scale: 88 JGEX constructions, 92 rules (adding R43-R48 center concurrencies, R44 Pappus, R45 Simson, R52-R53 Hypotenuse-Leg, R70 Harmonic Conjugate, R85-R90 metric laws), and native .ggb ingestion.
strengths: Fixes AlphaGeometry's rconst log-ratio hallucination bug with regression test test_ar_ratio_hallucination.
Extends rulebase with explicit center theorems, Pappus, harmonic conjugates, Hypotenuse-Leg congruence, and C++ Yuclid squared-length AR.
Ingests interactive GeoGebra (.ggb) archives directly into formal deductive states.
blind_spots: Python SympyARDeductor does not yet route lequation squared-length rules (R85-R90), and R57_PYTHAGORAS_THEOREM is commented out in DEFAULT_RULES.
Still relies on floating-point close_enough pre-filtering, float numerical guards, and float MILP traceback.
No conic sections, 3D solids, or exact radical coordinate synthesis.
systems.geometor_takeaway: Newclid's ' | ' auxiliary separator, explicit orientation-split rules, and Yuclid's squared-length AR validate building an exact SymPy quadrance/spread/area AR deductor directly over geometor.model.

systems.name: Java Geometry Expert (JGEX / Area Method)
primitives: P_ABC = AB^2 + BC^2 - AC^2 Pythagoras difference
systems.underlying_algebra_or_logic: Five-engine synthesis: Geometry Deductive Database (GDD), Full-Angle backward elimination, Chou-Gao-Zhang Coordinate-Free Area Method, Wu's Characteristic Set triangulation, and Buchberger Gröbner Bases.
systems.metric_treatment: Coordinate-free polynomials in signed parallel ratios r, signed triangle/quadrilateral areas S_ABC / S_ABCD, and Pythagoras differences P_ABC / P_ABCD (= 2 AC · BD).
systems.diorismos_and_degeneracy: Automatic extraction of algebraic non-degeneracy denominators (NDGs: S_UPVQ != 0, P_UVU != 0) during pseudo-remainder elimination or Rabinowitsch saturation u_k * g_k - 1 = 0.
systems.verification_engine: Visual forward saturation (GDD), full-angle elimination (Full.java), backward point elimination (Elim.java), and Ritt-Wu / Gröbner polynomial reduction over Q.
systems.signature_opus_scale: Historical origin of the 43 GDD rules and clause DSL; ships hundreds of classic theorems across exs-book/ch2-ch3, 4_PYTH (20 Pythagorean proofs), Menelaus, Ceva, Pappus, Pascal, Simson, Miquel, and Inversion.
strengths: The Area Method eliminates constructed points in reverse order via short, human-readable coordinate-free identities in {r, S_ABC, P_ABC} with zero auxiliary constructions.
Proves Pythagoras (P_BAC = 0 by definition!), Orthocenter (0 steps via Jacobi identity), Ceva, Menelaus, Pappus, and La Hire inversion effortlessly.
Automatically discovers exact algebraic non-degeneracy conditions (NDGs) required for theorem validity.
blind_spots: Forensic audit reveals Area.java (213 lines) is an unfinished C-to-Java port with the GUI 'A' tab disabled in PanelProve.java:112-116 ('TODO: Implement the area method').
Wu and Gröbner engines sacrifice geometric intuition for opaque coordinate polynomials with hundreds of monomials.
Monolithic Java Swing architecture tightly couples theorem proving to legacy mutable arrays.
systems.geometor_takeaway: Implement Chou-Gao-Zhang's complete coordinate-free Area Method (signed_area2 + pythagoras_diff point elimination) in clean Python/SymPy inside geometor, finishing what JGEX left disabled.

systems.name: Projective & Conformal Geometric Algebra (kingdon / galgebra)
systems.paradigm: Covariant Clifford Multivector Calculi (2D PGA & 2D CGA)
primitives: 2D PGA Cl(2,0,1): grade-1 Line, grade-2 Point/Direction, grade-3 Pseudoscalar
2D CGA Cl(3,1): grade-1 Null Point / Dual Circle, grade-2 Point Pair, grade-3 Circle / Flat Line
systems.underlying_algebra_or_logic: Graded Clifford algebras over quadratic spaces where geometric entities are blades (outer/regressive products) and all isometries/inversions are sandwich products V >> X = ±V X ~V.
systems.metric_treatment: In PGA, line norm^2 (l | l) is quadrance and inner product (l1 | l2) encodes cosine/orthogonality; in CGA, null inner product -2(P1 | P2) is exact Euclidean quadrance and -2(kappa | P) is Steiner circle power!
systems.diorismos_and_degeneracy: Projectively total: parallel lines meet in valid ideal Direction bivectors (e12=0) in PGA, and circles/lines unify seamlessly in CGA (lines are circles through infinity ni); point-pair square T^2 > 0, = 0, < 0 classifies real/tangent/imaginary intersections.
systems.verification_engine: Exact symbolic blade expansion via kingdon's RationalPolynomial + poly_cse compiler over SymPy expressions.
systems.signature_opus_scale: Dimension-agnostic algebraic DSL covering incidence, orthogonal projections, reflections, rotors, motors, circle through 3 points (P1^P2^P3), radical axis (kappa1 - kappa2), and circle inversion (C >> P).
strengths: Eliminates case splits between finite and ideal points (PGA) and between lines and circles (CGA).
In 2D CGA, circle power is -2(kappa|P), radical axis is kappa1 - kappa2, circumcenter is C * ni * ~C, and circle inversion is the sandwich product C >> P!
kingdon compiles multivector products with CSE and executes seamlessly on exact sympy.Expr scalars.
blind_spots: galgebra crashes with AttributeError on A.dual() whenever I^2 = 0 (all degenerate PGAs!), lacks regressive '&', and overloads '>>' as commutator instead of sandwich product.
General non-circular conics (ellipses, hyperbolas, parabolas) require 6D Conic GA Cl(5,3) rather than 2D PGA or 2D CGA.
Pure blade algebra has no native notion of Euclidean construction step history or compass-and-straightedge lineage.
systems.geometor_takeaway: Expose lightweight 2D PGA and 2D CGA multivector lenses over geometor.model elements (with custom simp_func=sp.cancel) for division-free projective chains and 1-line conformal circle algebra.

systems.name: CindyJS (Complex Projective CP^2 & Cayley-Klein)
primitives: Homogeneous Point [x, y, z] in CP^2
Homogeneous Line [a, b, c] in CP^2
Circular Points at Infinity I=(1,i,0), J=(1,-i,0)
systems.underlying_algebra_or_logic: Complex projective plane CP^2 equipped with Cayley-Klein metric polarity relative to the degenerate fundamental conic pair (linf = [0,0,1], I, J).
systems.metric_treatment: Euclidean circles are conics through I and J; orthogonality is polarity l1^T diag(1,1,0) l2 = 0; Euclidean angle is Laguerre's cross-ratio (i/2) log CR(A_inf, B_inf; I, J).
systems.diorismos_and_degeneracy: Zero missing intersections over C: real-disjoint circles intersect at complex-conjugate points, and Tracing.js detours along a complex upper-half-plane semicircle to prevent discontinuous branch jumping!
systems.verification_engine: Randomized complex Schwartz-Zippel polynomial identity testing across 3 complex perturbations (Prover.js) + Ferguson-Bailey PSLQ minimal-polynomial recovery (PSLQ.js / guess(x)).
systems.signature_opus_scale: Complete dynamic projective + Euclidean + hyperbolic + elliptic + conic geometry engine (5-point Plücker conics, dual adjugate conics, pole-polar, rank-1 skew conic splitting, anti-Möbius inversion).
strengths: Join of two points and meet of two lines are the exact same 3D cross product List.cross(u, v); polar of p is C*p and pole of l is adj(C)*l.
Plücker 5-point conic pencil (ConicBy5) and Richter-Gebert skew-matrix conic intersection work uniformly for circles, ellipses, parabolas, and hyperbolas.
Riemann-surface homotopy continuation solves dynamic geometry's 'jumping elements' problem, and PSLQ recovers quadratic surds from floats.
blind_spots: Coordinates are IEEE-754 complex floats ({real, imag}), not exact symbolic algebraic expressions.
Randomized Prover.js gives probabilistic (Schwartz-Zippel) certainty rather than deductive proof certificates.
PSLQ guess(x) in PSLQ.js is capped at dimension n=3 (rationals, rational multiples of pi, and degree-2 quadratic surds).
systems.geometor_takeaway: Adopt CindyJS's 3x3 symmetric conic matrix + adjugate dual conic representation in exact SymPy inside geometor.model, and use arbitrary-precision mpmath PSLQ in geometor.divine to scout degree-d algebraic invariants.

systems.name: SymPy Geometry (sympy.geometry 1.14.0)
systems.underlying_algebra_or_logic: Direct affine Cartesian equations over SymPy Basic expressions, delegating non-linear intersections to generic CAS polynomial solvers.
systems.metric_treatment: Symbolic Euclidean distance sqrt(dx^2 + dy^2), acos dot-product angles, signed/unsigned polygon area, and explicit Triangle center properties.
systems.diorismos_and_degeneracy: Auto-collapses degenerate entities in __new__ (Segment(p, p) -> Point(p); Circle of 3 collinear points -> Line); returns empty list [] when parallel lines or disjoint circles miss over R.
systems.verification_engine: Symbolic simplification via pervasive eager simplify() (37 call sites) and generic sympy.solvers.solve().
systems.signature_opus_scale: 11 geometry modules (~12,071 LOC) + combinatorics/polyhedron.py (1,020 LOC): 2D/3D points/lines/planes, axis-aligned ellipses, parabolas, polygons, and classical triangle centers.
strengths: Clean, familiar Pythonic entity hierarchy integrated directly with SymPy's symbolic expression tree.
Built-in exact properties for Triangle (incenter, centroid, circumcenter, orthocenter, nine_point_circle, eulerline, medial) and Polygon moments.
Serves as the lightweight entity substrate extended by geometor.model.
blind_spots: Live double bug in Triangle.excenters (polygon.py:2714-2726): missing numerator parentheses (-a*x0 + b*x1 + c*x2/(-a+b+c)) plus wrong side-vertex pairing!
Live precision bug in Point.affine_rank (point.py:331-335): abs(x.n(2)) < 1e-12 causes exact Rational non-collinear points to falsely report collinear!

Calls generic solve() inside Circle/Ellipse.intersection (stalling on radical towers), raises NotImplementedError on rotated Ellipse, and lacks Hyperbola, general Conic, circle power/radical_axis/inversion/pole/polar, and projective cross_ratio.
systems.geometor_takeaway: Confirms why geometor.model must bypass Circle.intersection/solve() with closed-form radical-axis + ANP field arithmetic, while giving GEOMETOR concrete upstream SymPy bug-fix PRs to contribute.

systems.name: Oliver Byrne's Coloured Euclid (1847 / Rougeux)
systems.host_language: Typographic Chromatic DSL (1847 Woodblock / 2018 Interactive SVG+CSS)
primitives: Inline Coloured Segment Glyph (red / blue / yellow / black; solid / dashed / dotted)
Inline Coloured Polygon / Square / Circle Region Glyph
systems.underlying_algebra_or_logic: Euclid Books I-VI rewritten as a pointer-free visual pseudocode: eliminates indirect vertex-letter dereferencing (AB, ∠ABC, △ABC) in favor of direct inline chromatic value-tokens inside structured Given / To Prove / Construction / Proof equation blocks.
systems.metric_treatment: Direct visual-algebraic magnitude equations (=, +, -, >, <) over inline segment icons, angle-wedge icons, polygonal area icons (Book II geometric algebra), and four-term Eudoxian proportion ribbons (A : B :: C : D in Books V-VI).
systems.diorismos_and_degeneracy: Encoded typographically via stroke grammar (solid strokes for Given hypotheses, dashed/dotted strokes for auxiliary Construction loci) and parenthetical marginal Axiom/Proposition citations.
systems.verification_engine: Human visual pattern-matching with zero vertex-pointer chasing (1847 Chiswick Press 4-color Caslon woodblocks; re-engineered in Nicholas Rougeux's 2018 interactive SVG/CSS linked-hover web edition c82.net/euclid).
systems.signature_opus_scale: Books I-VI of Euclid's Elements (268 pages, 1847): ~173 planar constructions/theorems across Books I-IV & VI plus Book V visual magnitude proportions—including Golden Ratio (II.11, VI.30) and Regular Pentagon (IV.10-11)!
strengths: Pioneers pointer-free (tacit) geometric notation: eliminates cognitive context-switching between prose vertex strings ('∠ABC') and diagram labels.
Partitions every proposition into scannable vertical pseudocode blocks (Given -> To Prove -> Construction -> Proof with '∴'), anticipating @proposition and modern tactic scripts by 175 years.
Covers Book II gnomons, Book III circle power (III.35-36), Book IV pentagon (IV.10-11), and Book VI golden ratio (VI.30)—domains omitted by modern ITPs!
blind_spots: Combinatorial palette ceiling: 4 colors × 3 stroke styles (~12 distinct tokens) saturate on dense projective configurations or 9-point diagrams.
0D points lack first-class visual value-tokens ('the point where [red] meets [blue]'), making pure point-collinearity (Pappus), Tarski betweenness, or 53,000 triangle centers awkward to express.
Stops after Book VI (omitting Books VII-X number theory/incommensurables and Books XI-XIII Platonic solids) and requires a symbolic backing layer to be greppable or machine-checked.
systems.geometor_takeaway: GEOMETOR's bidirectional :g: role <-> .euclid-graphic data-ref hover highlighting synthesizes classical symbolic pointer precision with Byrne/Rougeux zero-dereference visual perception—and motivates an inline Byrne micro-glyph mode in photon-platform/publish.

systems.name: GEOMETOR (geometor.model + Ecosystem)
systems.paradigm: Exact Constructive Symbolic DAG + Multi-Lens Algebra
primitives: Line, Segment, Circle, Wedge, Polygon, Section
systems.underlying_algebra_or_logic: Targeted constructive ancestral DAG (auto_intersect=False) backed by closed-form radical-axis intersections, QQ.algebraic_field(ext) canonicalization, and Rational Trigonometry polynomial invariants.
systems.metric_treatment: Dual exact symbolic lens: polynomial Rational Trigonometry invariants (quadrance Q, spread s, signed_area2, cross_ratio) paired with exact closed-form radical coordinates over Q(phi), Q(sqrt(d)), and nested towers.
systems.diorismos_and_degeneracy: Strict Model.__setitem__ validation banning float/sp.Float atoms, paired with System E-equivalent topological root selectors (side_of, between, beyond, on_ray, other_than) and scoped subconstruction folding.
systems.verification_engine: Exact algebraic zero_test (expand -> primitive_element ANP reduction -> cancel -> high-precision guard) + structured @proposition assertions (assert_equal, assert_spread_equal, assert_perpendicular, assert_parallel, assert_congruent, assert_area_equal).
systems.signature_opus_scale: 33-repository ecosystem across 7 architectural layers uniting 831 Heath Euclid SVGs, Byrne visual pseudocode, Proclus/Aristotle/Aquinas/Hoenen/Hilbert noetics, Elements, Wildberger, Pappus, ETC (53,144 centers), Divine, and Seer.
strengths: 100% exact symbolic coordinate synthesis (zero float contamination) capable of building deep nested compass-and-straightedge towers where generic CAS solve() hangs.

Unites Euclidean constructive lineage (Given -> Construct -> Demonstrate), topological root selection, Rational Trigonometry invariants, and Byrne/Rougeux-grade interactive :g: <-> .euclid-graphic SVGs.
Bridges primary historical treatises (Digital Scriptorium) directly to executable symbolic code and automated discovery (divine, seer).
blind_spots: algebra.zero_test (lines 247-251) falls back to heuristic abs(evalf(80)) < 1e-65 when count_ops > 25 instead of constructive BFMSS algebraic root-separation bounds.
Step telemetry currently omits Lemoine Géométrographie complexity counts (R1, R2, C1, C2, C3) and omits persisted selector ASTs needed for 1-to-1 LeanEuclid export.
Core model still lacks first-class Circle power/radical_axis/inversion/pole/polar and 3x3 projective Conic matrices (currently split partially into pappus).
systems.geometor_takeaway: Synthesize the strongest ideas of all 10 peer systems: BFMSS-certified zero_test, persisted selector ASTs + Lemoine complexity on Step, Byrne/Rougeux micro-glyph :g: tokens, native inversion/conic/area-method modules, and Function-First Elements 2.0.
